LIST abs(THE MAXIMUM j IN PlayerAttribute [has api Player: 6] has PlayerAttributeJumping j - THE MAXIMUM j2 IN PlayerAttribute [has api Player: 23] has PlayerAttributeJumping j2)
note: PlayerAttribute is a time series (one row per FIFA snapshot date) with no date given in the question, so 'players 6 and 23's jumping scores' is inherently ambiguous. Interpreted as each player's peak (career-high) jumping score, and 'difference' as an unsigned magnitude.

answer: LIST id FROM PlayerAttribute [has PlayerAttributePreferredFoot: 'right'] has api Player has PlayerId id AND ALSO has PlayerAttributePotential p AND ALSO THE MINIMUM p GROUPED BY id AS m ORDERED WITH m ASCENDING THE FIRST 4
note: Potential is also a time series; interpreted 'lowest potential players' as each right-footed player's own minimum recorded potential, then took the 4 lowest such players. The 4th place is tied with another player on minimum potential (44), so which one the database returns for that slot is arbitrary.
